answer_1.quote: We fine-tuned Gemma2-2b on the MetaMathQA  dataset and evaluated on GSM8K (5-shots) to assess the models' multi-step mathematical reasoning ability. Furthermore, we fine-tuned Llama3-8b on the CodeFeedback , to evaluate on the HumanEval and MBPP which are aimed to test the code generation ability of models.
